Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 62, "heading": "CHAPTER 60. AGNES", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u062-b0030", "target": "Я стоял у окна и смотрел через старинную улицу на дома напротив, вспоминая, как наблюдал за ними в дождливые дни, когда впервые приехал сюда; как любил гадать о людях, появлявшихся в каком-нибудь из окон, и провожал их глазами вверх и вниз по лестницам, пока женщины семенили по тротуару, цокая деревянными подошвами-паттенами, а унылый дождь падал косыми линиями, хлестал из водосточной трубы вон там и стекал на мостовую. Чувство, с которым я смотрел когда-то на бродяг, входивших в город в те дождливые вечера, в сумерках, и ковылявших мимо с узелками, свисавшими с палок на плечах, вернулось ко мне свежим, как прежде насыщенное запахом сырой земли, мокрых листьев и шиповника и ощущением тех самых ветров, что обдували меня на моём собственном тяжком пути.", "source_sha256": "e06341051bbb855774cf3746af2fa61f015eaf00fc8eb1b274d8f5e8de6a36ee", "target_id": "ru-en85-u062-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "8ded06274ea03628a9321c16d377ed0d9c59e490c3f223e239e5f2281989d68a"}, {"source_id": "en85-u062-b0031", "target": "Скрипнувшая дверца в панельной стене заставила меня вздрогнуть и обернуться. Её прекрасные, безмятежные глаза встретились с моими, когда она шла ко мне. Она остановилась и прижала руку к груди, а я заключил её в объятия.", "source_sha256": "0ae54d6dc6e1de8889c368597bd0887189a3f48a68dbb4db5cc61b0262c78431", "target_id": "ru-en85-u062-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "eb2f88c63ada1880d6d1d412d3fdda544300067c9f85fa61b71131460e244b0e"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 60, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u062-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Agnes! my dear girl! I have come too suddenly upon you.’", "sha256": "eca71c3565072cfaeef12b70f5c903159bde2c05d16dd3a5be693959d94730fe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, no! I am so rejoiced to see you, Trotwood!’", "sha256": "1bf5bec118fc74dcfb209814775e0b096a246093cc185b0e20214b7011413ef1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dear Agnes, the happiness it is to me, to see you once again!’", "sha256": "fb95e39bcd807fecb80a0d6ca8b31f27448aac733e2ce11191df77f2f357f1bd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I folded her to my heart, and, for a little while, we were both silent. Presently we sat down, side by side; and her angel-face was turned upon me with the welcome I had dreamed of, waking and sleeping, for whole years.", "sha256": "93c01dadd8414434cfaa7d29824c1f9752110bc3c3427164f3e87979c842a8ee", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She was so true, she was so beautiful, she was so good,—I owed her so much gratitude, she was so dear to me, that I could find no utterance for what I felt. I tried to bless her, tried to thank her, tried to tell her (as I had often done in letters) what an influence she had upon me; but all my efforts were in vain. My love and joy were dumb.", "sha256": "f517ab8f7df19d5502805666f6b48988405154e76e067f71294738533dfc4b2a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "With her own sweet tranquillity, she calmed my agitation; led me back to the time of our parting; spoke to me of Emily, whom she had visited, in secret, many times; spoke to me tenderly of Dora’s grave. With the unerring instinct of her noble heart, she touched the chords of my memory so softly and harmoniously, that not one jarred within me; I could listen to the sorrowful, distant music, and desire to shrink from nothing it awoke. How could I, when, blended with it all, was her dear self, the better angel of my life?", "sha256": "006dfdce0cf36ad2d04e58a4ddbcce7b1436e2b83702ea5b1a9aa3c8d52c3d2e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And you, Agnes,’ I said, by and by. ‘Tell me of yourself. You have hardly ever told me of your own life, in all this lapse of time!’", "sha256": "1ebc142eb4a7c7a9aa22cc041064c8a617080624a4fd6a6cbc2bcc89e40b7fd6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What should I tell?’ she answered, with her radiant smile. ‘Papa is well. You see us here, quiet in our own home; our anxieties set at rest, our home restored to us; and knowing that, dear Trotwood, you know all.’", "sha256": "ec4f0b45e25400147fdd81553c03d0099894fe46ff6bd33e5696edef3b750a56", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘All, Agnes?’ said I.", "sha256": "e416ae80a79594d4a869a1f0f2ac5294fd9565bd9882b0763c6763d1dbafe419", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She looked at me, with some fluttering wonder in her face.", "sha256": "750d95c93bdc5770592adddfa7f19cfb058c158b80e688f4cd27db0678922189", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is there nothing else, Sister?’ I said.", "sha256": "5e8541820ec9c7b6ac50db173d6cc29bf3996ce29895e7f892f89ebe34ae8084", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Her colour, which had just now faded, returned, and faded again. She smiled; with a quiet sadness, I thought; and shook her head.", "sha256": "93d446d1a35a275ae1d51ddbf902016985d71a99118156a5908429bf3571a49a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I had sought to lead her to what my aunt had hinted at; for, sharply painful to me as it must be to receive that confidence, I was to discipline my heart, and do my duty to her. I saw, however, that she was uneasy, and I let it pass.", "sha256": "7392413f964e1f53b44a27efa08eac2d0598f27b72e788cf45e3f383f0ab5f85", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You have much to do, dear Agnes?’", "sha256": "c73717a27517f883d141b6a6d6884cb4f4d5ce00cb3cd2bedc97a530375683bc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘With my school?’ said she, looking up again, in all her bright composure.", "sha256": "d950fca279951e3b70c8b82b722622252271c47eaec80915305aef6df9ae2f22", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes. It is laborious, is it not?’", "sha256": "938b9d5142782934db303ab159c5a6d270096281ed8d98c0ee09ac0bbfceaacf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The labour is so pleasant,’ she returned, ‘that it is scarcely grateful in me to call it by that name.’", "sha256": "49306e63161d9621c44af35b809307593432654abfa7eec4f4da28e952912128", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Nothing good is difficult to you,’ said I.", "sha256": "39e2fc7be0eeb78b700840c594c7d9d2a3db0d252d00683a3e43c745fda4a409", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Her colour came and went once more; and once more, as she bent her head, I saw the same sad smile.", "sha256": "200c081ad06541bafb827a95e7203e7db57c79b3e595c847a69672a1d06ed343", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You will wait and see papa,’ said Agnes, cheerfully, ‘and pass the day with us? Perhaps you will sleep in your own room? We always call it yours.’", "sha256": "e111d803ba116263079c39ccaa9f994fdd8becdc82f5905e8bd68ae31ed47e8b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I could not do that, having promised to ride back to my aunt’s at night; but I would pass the day there, joyfully.", "sha256": "f2b949f86692cdd13d8150ad4b785acebbb5c794d0b5f12be90b2f4d1655ae44", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I must be a prisoner for a little while,’ said Agnes, ‘but here are the old books, Trotwood, and the old music.’", "sha256": "622dd619f33a3c527861d7a140210410ff59da8a2aae301dd3f086fd2319aefd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Even the old flowers are here,’ said I, looking round; ‘or the old kinds.’", "sha256": "0a7da0de1447dd785d57b7d91137c6ed98fb6334c2f01267eda1cb1a46174531", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I have found a pleasure,’ returned Agnes, smiling, ‘while you have been absent, in keeping everything as it used to be when we were children. For we were very happy then, I think.’", "sha256": "73e79dec20b969762ab85344131f692486f0384daa74198ca623113ee7702fad", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Heaven knows we were!’ said I.", "sha256": "a37208d881ff2f47160c8d94d13afb167ac0fc397ca0ebe94d7e218191d45930", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And every little thing that has reminded me of my brother,’ said Agnes, with her cordial eyes turned cheerfully upon me, ‘has been a welcome companion. Even this,’ showing me the basket-trifle, full of keys, still hanging at her side, ‘seems to jingle a kind of old tune!’", "sha256": "32ece679756072683a3360ca774482af806879fae67f23cfcc225c6474d1b046", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She smiled again, and went out at the door by which she had come.", "sha256": "6b2ed6b6a7c36a92981e8d1508775c33e58e650571fb9b35413a9eb38efc4df6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was for me to guard this sisterly affection with religious care. It was all that I had left myself, and it was a treasure. If I once shook the foundations of the sacred confidence and usage, in virtue of which it was given to me, it was lost, and could never be recovered. I set this steadily before myself. The better I loved her, the more it behoved me never to forget it.", "sha256": "8418d10def7e5eaa74186fd3a0d8ff3408e7a477d1c8d363b09959ba6432dd9c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I walked through the streets; and, once more seeing my old adversary the butcher—now a constable, with his staff hanging up in the shop—went down to look at the place where I had fought him; and there meditated on Miss Shepherd and the eldest Miss Larkins, and all the idle loves and likings, and dislikings, of that time. Nothing seemed to have survived that time but Agnes; and she, ever a star above me, was brighter and higher.", "sha256": "3c44c2b07bbacb8ce0e28f856149e5cce11048b0e04a1c95db0986efac613ab0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "When I returned, Mr. Wickfield had come home, from a garden he had, a couple of miles or so out of town, where he now employed himself almost every day. I found him as my aunt had described him. We sat down to dinner, with some half-dozen little girls; and he seemed but the shadow of his handsome picture on the wall.", "sha256": "af5539d79426c2f5eb1b2c85042b2b10c7f1db4e7eb22bc325648420d471a480", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The tranquillity and peace belonging, of old, to that quiet ground in my memory, pervaded it again. When dinner was done, Mr. Wickfield taking no wine, and I desiring none, we went up-stairs; where Agnes and her little charges sang and played, and worked. After tea the children left us; and we three sat together, talking of the bygone days.", "sha256": "8be3bb528b4bd1ac303de3d61d64f1fcb24268bbb7c78d064d7193fb791211a6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u062-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My part in them,’ said Mr. Wickfield, shaking his white head, ‘has much matter for regret—for deep regret, and deep contrition, Trotwood, you well know. But I would not cancel it, if it were in my power.’", "sha256": "76e657eace72475698ced7599cf4db35835f08cbb742b737871f9a58f77639cb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[67]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
